notes:
The MessageImprint of the TimeStampReq and of the committed TimeStampToken in
Appendix A.2 is DD9471EF...3EEAF7C8. Section 3.1.1 computes the CTT imprint of
the very same COSE_Sign1 (RFC 9052 Appendix C.2.1, signature 8eb33e4c...cacb36)
as SHA-256 over the CBOR-encoded signature field, 0x5840 followed by the 64
signature bytes, and prints 44C2419D...54763B4E. That value is correct and can
be reproduced with any SHA-256 implementation; the value in Appendix A.2
cannot. As a result, the token of Appendix A.2 does not satisfy the mandatory
check of Section 4 ("the receiver MUST make sure that the MessageImprint in the
embedded timestamp token matches a hash of [...] the signature") for the message
it is embedded in, and an implementation that uses the appendix as a test
vector must reject it.

The cause is in the example generator of the draft's source repository
(https://github.com/ietf-scitt/draft-birkholz-cose-tsa-tst-header-parameter,
example/ctt/create-example.sh). The script extracts the signature from in.diag
with `awk '/signature/ {print $4}'` and pipes it through diag2cbor.rb to obtain
the bytes to hash. Commit 58407a7b (2025-05-12, "apply line folding on
synthesis") folded in.diag at 69 columns, so the signature literal spans three
lines and awk returns only the first,
h'8eb33e4ca31d1c465ab05aac34cc6b23d58fef5c083106c4d
an unterminated literal. diag2cbor.rb (cbor-diag 0.11.8) rejects it and prints
a parse error; `set -o pipefail` does not propagate into the <(...) process
substitution, so `openssl ts -query -data` hashed the error message when
commit 086f7f79 (2025-08-29, "update CTT examples") regenerated the token.
SHA-256 of that error text, verbatim (two lines, each terminated by a newline,
200 bytes in total):

*** can't parse h'8eb33e4ca31d1c465ab05aac34cc6b23d58fef5c083106c4d
*** Expected one of [ \t\n\r], "/", [0-9a-fA-F], [^\\'\t], "\\", "\\u", "'" at line 2, column 1 (byte 53) after h'8eb33e4ca31d1c465ab05aac34cc6b23d58fef5c083106c4d

is exactly DD9471EFE743C4051335DF8F6D2882F3BADC387700F7ED3F7091672A3EEAF7C8.
(The backslash sequences on the second line are literal characters of the
grammar diag2cbor.rb prints, not escapes.) The token of the previous revision
of the example (repository state before 086f7f79) carried the correct
44C2419D... imprint. Appendix A.1 is generated by a script that hashes a
literal string and is not affected: its imprint 09E638D4... is
SHA-256("This is the content.") as Section 3.2 requires.

The normative text of Section 3.1 and the worked computation of Section 3.1.1
are consistent with each other; only the appendix needs correction. Since the
token is signed by the TSA (freetsa.org), the corrected appendix requires a
newly issued token over the 44C2419D... imprint rather than an edit of the
existing bytes.
